post.description: Records a balanced double-entry journal. Receipt/refund entries require paymentMethod.name: CASH posts to CASH ON HAND; ZELLE and DEPOSIT require a BANK paymentAccount; CHECK posts to CHECKS TO DEPOSIT unless a BANK paymentAccount is supplied; CREDIT-CARD posts to CARD PROCESSOR RECEIVABLE. PAYMENT and INITIAL-PAYMENT accept account as a backward-compatible Zelle/deposit destination alias. incomeStatement.id or incomeStatementId must reference an open statement. INITIAL-PAYMENT without invoice.id creates a PENDING invoice and accepts either employee or vehicleRoute/route/employeeGroup assignees, including zero-amount registrations. Employee and route assignees are mutually exclusive after normalization: employee clears route fields, route clears employee. Response data is PostEntryResult with current statement totals.
Advanced search for journals with nested AND/OR filter groups in the request body (Stripe-style search). Returns the same array shape as List all.

parameters.description: Optional filter query (field, operator, filters, pagination, sort)
parameters.name: body

get.description: Requires journal view permission.

put.description: Re-posts an existing journal with PostEntryRequest (same ID) using the same payment-account rules as creation. incomeStatement.id must reference an open income statement. INITIAL-PAYMENT and VOID entries are managed through the invoice lifecycle and cannot be updated here. Requires journal update permission.

delete.description: Removes the journal document. Running totals are calculated dynamically, so nothing is recalculated; the only exception is an invoice-payment entry, where the invoice's stored total is updated to remove the deleted entry's effect. Deleting INITIAL-PAYMENT also removes the linked PENDING invoice stub when it has not been completed. VOID entries cannot be deleted here. Requires journal delete permission.
